name: CLB v7.0.15 Spotify Fast Atomic Sync
notes: Cumulative from v7.0.11. Preserves Atomic Play Sync and starts the first Spotify controller from the early head bootstrap, reuses that controller in Music, adds focused Spotify preconnects, queues a first Play tap while readiness finishes, and shortens silent-failure handoff without ever spinning the record before confirmed playback.
